FALLBACK.MESSAGE_TITLE: Sorry, something went wrong with this application
FALLBACK.MESSAGE_FEEDBACK: Our team has been notified. If you would like to help, please, tell us what happened below.

FLANKER.WELCOME_MESSAGE: You will be performing a test assessing attentional control.
FLANKER.INSTRUCTIONS_OVERVIEW: In this test, you will see a row of five symbols appearing briefly on the screen. Your goal is to focus only on the arrow in the centre and ignore the symbols on the sides.
FLANKER.RESPONSE_LEFT: If the centre arrow points to the LEFT, press the LEFT arrow key (←) as fast as possible.
FLANKER.RESPONSE_RIGHT: If the centre arrow points to the RIGHT, press the RIGHT arrow key (→) as fast as possible.
FLANKER.EXAMPLES_TITLE: Here are a few examples (you don't have to do anything for now):
FLANKER.EXAMPLE_CONGRUENT:
Arrow in the centre points RIGHT. All arrows on the sides point in the same direction.
Press the RIGHT key.
FLANKER.EXAMPLE_INCONGRUENT:
Arrow in the centre points LEFT. All arrows on the sides point in the opposite direction.
Press the LEFT key.
FLANKER.EXAMPLE_NEUTRAL:
Arrow in the centre points RIGHT. Symbols on the sides do not point in any direction.
Press the RIGHT key.
FLANKER.REMEMBER_NOTE: Remember: Only the arrow in the centre matters. Ignore the symbols on the sides.
FLANKER.DURATION_NOTE: The full test will last about 5 minutes without breaks.
FLANKER.FIXATION_NOTE: Before each row appears on the screen, a cross (+) will be shown in the centre. Keep your eyes on it while waiting for each row of symbols to appear — this will help you focus.
FLANKER.ACCURACY_NOTE: Please respond as accurately as possible. Speed is important, but being correct is more important. Mistakes are expected — don't worry. Try your best.
FLANKER.INSTRUCTIONS_CENTER_FOCUS: Remember to focus on the center arrow. The surrounding symbols may or may not point in the same direction, but you should only respond based on the center arrow.
FLANKER.TASK_RULES_DESCRIPTION: There are three types of trials:
FLANKER.CONGRUENT_DESC: All five arrows point in the same direction.
FLANKER.INCONGRUENT_DESC: The center arrow points in one direction, but the surrounding arrows point in the opposite direction.
FLANKER.NEUTRAL_DESC: The surrounding symbols are dashes (—), only the center arrow conveys direction.
FLANKER.IGNORE_FLANKERS: Important: You must ignore the direction of the surrounding symbols and only respond to the center arrow.
FLANKER.SPEED_ACCURACY_BALANCE: Try to be both fast and accurate. Both speed and accuracy are important for this task.
FLANKER.PRACTICE_INTRO_MESSAGE: Before the main task, you will complete a short practice session. This will help you get familiar with the task and understand how to distinguish the center arrow from the surrounding symbols.

MAIN_TASK.READY_MESSAGE: You have completed the practice session. You will now begin the main task. Remember to focus on the center arrow and ignore the surrounding symbols!
MAIN_TASK.PRESS_TO_BEGIN: Press spacebar to begin the main task
MAIN_TASK.COMPLETE_MESSAGE: Congratulations! You have completed the Flanker task.

BREAK.TITLE: Take a Break
BREAK.MESSAGE: You have completed a portion of the task. Feel free to take a short break.
BREAK.PRESS_TO_CONTINUE: Or press spacebar to continue immediately

SETTINGS.CONGRUENT_PERCENTAGE_HELP: Percentage of trials where flankers match the center arrow
SETTINGS.INCONGRUENT_PERCENTAGE_HELP: Percentage of trials where flankers are opposite to the center arrow
SETTINGS.NEUTRAL_PERCENTAGE_HELP: Percentage of trials where flankers are dashes (remaining after congruent + incongruent)
SETTINGS.ITI_HELP: Blank time between stimulus offset and next trial (500-5000 ms)
SETTINGS.SHOW_FIXATION_CROSS: Show fixation cross during inter-trial interval
SETTINGS.DISPLAY_DURATION_HELP: How long each number is shown (100-2000 ms)
SETTINGS.CUSTOM_PRACTICE_SEQUENCE_HELP: Leave empty for random sequence. Enter comma-separated digits (0-9): 3,5,2,5,7,8,5,...
SETTINGS.CUSTOM_SEQUENCE_HELP: Leave empty for random sequence. Enter comma-separated digits (0-9): 3,5,2,5,7,8,5,...
